'''Scolex Grath''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a member of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG" />
